pivot_coordinate_system: Top-left pixels, x right/y down; normalized Unity pivot=(x/width,1-y/height).
foliage_grid_anchor: First logical cell center [48,48], separate from visual root. Source frame padding is never used as grid spacing.
filter: Point/Nearest for pixel sprites and foliage; Bilinear only for smooth soap bubbles.
alpha: Straight RGBA; no visible terrain/sky matte at foreground outline; alpha=0 RGB=0.
palette_policy: Reference-resolution source body colors retained; edge outlines use Sweetie16. New foliage uses up to 5 Sweetie16 colors (4 used). Stylized smooth pink bubble is the requested non-pixel exception.
